text: incident: slack workspace auth provider (okta) is down - reports of users unable to sign in since 09:14 PT. opening bridge.
two new hires (apr-22 start dates) blocked on day-1 onboarding because they can't get into slack. provisioning tickets queued but un-actionable until SSO is back.
okta has restored. backfilling provisioning now. postmortem writeup tomorrow.
